backend_count_note: backend_count = 5 = the core flash backends: esptool (ESP32), qflipper (Flipper Zero), adb (Android), sd (Pi/SBC SD-image; also registered under the 'sd-image' key, same handler), and rtl8720 (Realtek AmebaD / BW16 ImageTool). flash_engine._backends ALSO registers 5 phase-3 scaffolds that are argv/flow unit-tested but board-validation-pending (no real board yet) and are excluded from the count: cc2538_bsl (TI CC2652/Sniffle), hackrf_spiflash (HackRF/PortaPack Mayhem), dfu (RP2040/generic USB-DFU), uf2 (UF2 bootloaders), nrf_dfu (Nordic nRF52). No backend is advertised as hardware-validated yet — real-silicon write+verify validation is in progress (see command-center HIL-2026-07-28); round the count up only when a specific scaffold genuinely flashes a real board. Source: src/core/flash_engine.py FlashEngine._backends.
interface_count_note: desktop GUI, headless/localhost web, CLI, and the Cyber Controller broadcast/coordination surface. Source: README 'one screen' / the 4 interfaces line.
